name: Empacer
summary: Voice-first AI business assistant for SMB owners that drafts posts, replies and docs for approval.
description: Empacer remembers business context from a short setup, then turns spoken requests into customer replies, social posts, invoices and plans. Nothing is sent without the owner's approval. Available on web and Android (iOS via browser). Differentiator is owner-facing voice ops with persistent business memory rather than a generic chatbot. Official pricing page states the assistant is paid only (no free assistant tier); exact amounts shown at checkout.
features: Persistent business memory from a short setup
Voice requests turned into customer replies and social posts
Web and Android apps (iOS via browser)
